description: This PHP file defines a subpanel view for displaying project tasks related to a project within the SuiteCRM application. It sets up the interface elements, including a form and a list view, and handles layout and header configurations specific to this subpanel.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in the SuiteCRM UI.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new template for the ListView with specified HTML template and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables or images to the template for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title of the list view, typically showing the panel's title.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets custom header HTML content, such as buttons.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Defines the query parameters for fetching list data.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Renders the list view with the provided data and configuration.
